title: Mixing Times and Cutoff for the Rook's Walk
summary: We study the mixing time of the Rook's Walk Markov chain on a $d$-dimensional chess board of side length $n\geq 3$, where a rook moves by first selecting an axis uniformly at random and then selecting a new position along that axis uniformly from among the $n-1$ unoccupied alternatives. Our method is to lump the state space of the Rook's Walk by Hamming distance, yielding a birth-death Markov chain.
